text: On an annual basis, the Auditor General reviews the implementation status of outstanding Forensic Unit recommendations and reports the review results to City Council through the City's Audit Committee. This report provides the implementation status of the recommendations contained in the investigation report entitled "Auditor General's Observations of a Land Acquisition at Finch Avenue West and Arrow Road by the Toronto Parking Authority - Part 2" dated June 22, 2017. The report is available at: http://app.toronto.ca/tmmis/viewAgendaItemHistory.do?item=2017.AU9.12 . The investigation report contains six recommendations. In prior year follow-up reviews, we determined that three recommendations had been fully implemented.
